title: Hales's 2005 proof of the Kepler conjecture
summary: Thomas C. Hales's paper in Annals of Mathematics in 2005 states that no packing of congruent balls in three-dimensional Euclidean space has density greater than the face-centered cubic packing, a density the paper gives as π/√18, approximately 0.74.
body: Thomas C. Hales's paper "A proof of the Kepler conjecture", published in Annals of Mathematics 162 (2005), 1065–1185, states as Theorem 1.1: "No packing of congruent balls in Euclidean three space has density greater than that of the face-centered cubic packing." The paper gives the density of that packing as π/√18, approximately 0.74. It describes its own scope plainly: "The current paper presents an abridged form of the proof. The full proof appears in [Hal06a]." Hales also records that Samuel P. Ferguson contributed a difficult part through his Michigan thesis, and that Chapter 5 of the paper is coauthored with Ferguson.
